summary.en: Follow 500 winter sports bettors through the closures and restarts. A missing match can mean money kept, not necessarily money spent on another game. Compare monthly participation separately from the number of bets and spins.
summary.ja: 冬にスポーツへ賭けた500人を、競技の中断から再開まで追う。試合がなければ、別のゲームに移らず、お金を残すこともできる。月間の参加人数と、賭け・スピンの回数を分けて比較する。

questions.en: Who makes no bets at all in April, and which of those people return to real events in July? Inspect the two flags on each person's board.
questions.ja: 4月に全く賭けなかった人のうち、7月に実競技へ戻るのは誰か。個人ボードの二つの印で調べる。

questions.en: Do slot spins rise faster than the number of slot players? How many first-time players from before August play again in August?
questions.ja: スロットのスピン数は人数より速く増えるか。8月より前の新規参加者のうち、8月にも遊ぶ人は何人か。

questions.en: Does removing casino offers change take-up even with exactly the same fixture calendar?
questions.ja: 競技日程が同じでも、カジノへの勧誘をなくすと新規参加は変わるか。

assumptions.en: Nothing is fitted to the seven March–August outcome series. Sports active accounts and bets are the closest comparison, not a panel of unique winter bettors. The other operator series include non-sports customers: test timing and direction only.
assumptions.ja: 3～8月の実績7系列には合わせ込まない。実競技の口座・件数が最も近い比較対象だが、冬の利用者を追ったパネルではない。他商品の実績はスポーツ以外の顧客も含むため、方向と時期だけを検証する。

assumptions.en: Bets are dated within the week. Curves show the month of Monday: simulated month-to-date totals versus the supplied full-month observation. Compare only the last Monday point of each month; earlier points are incomplete, not forecasts. March indexes to itself. March 1 and August 31 lie outside the run. A missing March denominator displays 0, not an estimated index.
assumptions.ja: 各行動を実際の曜日に計上する。曲線は月曜の属する月について、月初来の累計と実績の月計を表示する。比較は各月最後の月曜の点で行う。それ以前の点は予測ではない。3月は自己比。3月1日・8月31日は対象外。3月の分母がゼロなら指数を推定せず0とする。

assumptions.en: Account demographics and annual sports turnover are proxies. The assumed turnover bands target a median £7.50 and mean £170.75, not an active-month spend. Football/racing overlap is assigned, not inferred from exclusive survey categories. Winter non-use is not lifetime non-use. Product histories overlap independently conditional on sex.
assumptions.ja: 口座の人口構成・年換算の賭け金を代理値とする。仮定した金額帯は中央値7.50ポンド・平均170.75ポンドを目安とし、利用月の金額ではない。サッカーと競馬の重複は仮定。冬の未利用と生涯未経験は区別し、商品の利用歴は性別内で独立に抽選する。

assumptions.en: Calendar dates are inputs; fixture opportunity weights, spending limits, session lengths, returned-stake fractions, work-budget effects and behavioural thresholds are assumptions, not estimated causal effects. Turnover includes re-staked returns. A weekly leisure wallet is separate from essential income; unused cash leaves the wallet at week end. No borrowing. The furlough grant is not treated as a known pay cut.
assumptions.ja: 日程は入力。賭ける機会の重み、予算、時間、払戻率、仕事による予算変化、行動の閾値は仮定であり、因果推定ではない。賭け金は払戻金の再使用も含む。週の娯楽費は生活費と別で、余りは週末に取り置き、借金はしない。休業助成を既知の減給率とは見なさない。

assumptions.en: Board and map retain cash wanted versus actually staked, cumulative first-ever slot starts, and pre-August starters seen again in August. Retention means at least one August spin, not uninterrupted weekly play. Optional shock probabilities, durations and sizes are illustrative assumptions.
assumptions.ja: ボードと地図に希望額と実額、スロット初参加の累計、8月前の初参加者の8月再利用を記録する。継続は毎週連続ではなく8月に1回以上の意味。任意ショックの確率・期間・規模は例示的な仮定。

scenario.en:
Great Britain, Monday 2 March to Sunday 30 August 2020 (26 weeks, one tick per week; week 0 starts on 2 March).

Follow 500 people who each had an online betting account and placed at least one sports bet in the winter of 2019-20. Take the mix of people from published statistics wherever they exist: football-only punters, people who mainly bet on horse racing, people who bet on anything that is on, how many of them already played online slots, casino games or poker before March, how much they stake in a month, their age, their work and how exposed their income was to furlough or job loss.

What happened, outside these people's control (use these dates as inputs): the Cheltenham Festival ran 10-13 March; English football was suspended on 13 March; British horse racing stopped after 17 March; the national lockdown began on 23 March. Through April and most of May there was almost no top-level sport: what a bookmaker could still offer was Belarusian football, table tennis, virtual sports and esports. German football returned on 16 May, British racing on 1 June, the Premier League on 17 June. July was packed with football; the season ended in late July and August was quieter.

Each week a person decides what to do with their betting: carry on exactly as before with whatever sport is on; stop and keep the money; bet on the unfamiliar sports that remain; move to virtual sports; play slots or casino games; play poker; and how much to stake. Operators send offers that point sports customers to casino products.

Record, as monthly indices where March = 100: the share of the cast active in real-event betting, in virtual betting, in slots, in other casino games and in poker (one person can be active in several), and the number of real-event bets and of slot spins. Also record money staked, how many people who had never played slots before started, and how many of those are still playing in August.

What-ifs worth trying: operators are not allowed to send cross-sell offers; sport returns a month earlier; furlough hits twice as many people.

Hypothesis to test: when sport stopped, most sports bettors simply stopped betting and came back when sport returned. Only a small minority moved to slots, poker or virtual sports, but that minority played more intensely, and some of them stayed after sport came back.

Reference data: every column is an observed outcome and none is an input. The figures are monthly, from the Gambling Commission's operator data, and each weekly row repeats the figure of its month (March = 100). Real-event betting is the like-for-like comparison. The slots, other gaming, virtual and poker figures cover all online customers, not only sports bettors, so compare their direction and timing, not their level.
